PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME" | grep -qE '^(Write|Edit)$'; then FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then echo "Formatting $FILE"; npx prettier --write "$FILE"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(js|mjs|cjs)$'; then echo "Linting $FILE"; npx eslint --fix "$FILE"; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.css$'; then echo "Stylelinting $FILE"; npx stylelint "$FILE" --config config/.stylelintrc.json --fix 2>&1 || echo "⚠ Stylelint errors remain — invoke /css-guide for guidance."; fi; fi; fi
